$comment: What is data (packed apart, never committed) and what is kept out of both. Read by scripts/sync-commit.ts and scripts/data.ts; .gitignore mirrors it, except data-minimal (the minimal data, unpacked: committed, but never code or data itself). Paths are relative to the project root; a folder covers everything under it.

minimalSkips.$comment: Left out of the minimal pack (pack --minimal): pictures scripts/fetch-images.ts downloads again from their source, blog originals (the site serves the WebP copies in public/blog-images), recordings, PDFs (lessons show without their PDF tab), and what restore builds again: the pronunciation list (scripts/build-pronunciation.ts) and the topic collocations index (scripts/build-topic-index.ts, from the per-topic files).
